Reason: the >=60 pool in sleep/anxiety/calm_relax is EXHAUSTED — of 10 banked phrases >=60 in these lanes, 8 are past-locks, same-concept, A/B losers or anti-patterns; only 'music before bed' (61) and 'relaxing instrumental music' (70) survive, and the second is textbook generic-soft. The prescreener itself now returns the contradiction: 'peaceful music for sleep' scores 62 AND is rejected as anti-pattern:generic_soft_framing_leads. The floor and the generic-soft anti-pattern disqualify each other, so the floor is not functioning as a gate. Counter-evidence to title rule (1) 'higher VidIQ = better lead' (which rests on n=2 concluded tests): 'Music to Sleep Through the Night' (CTR 7.15, best at scale) and 'Quiet Night Music' (6.53, 35.5% T1) are both distinctive low-search-volume leads. VidIQ measures SEARCH, which is 17% of channel traffic vs 27% suggested and 36% subscriber. THIS WEEK IS THE TEST: 3 ships at 30-31 against Monday's 66. If the low scorers land at or above the recent ~3% CTR floor, rule (1) needs re-derivation on a bigger sample.

⚠️ n=1 CELL. This is a coin flip, not a forecast. Recorded so the outcome is not read as evidence either way without more ships.

B leads with 'Rest Without Rushing' (FRESH, preflight 45 chars PASS_ACCEPTABLE) — a genuinely different keyword from A's 'Unwind Slowly', so this is two hypotheses per the A/B rule, not one keyword in two structures.

⚠️ HOW TO USE THE B VARIANT — unresolved as of 2026-08-02, written to serve either case. YouTube's Test & Compare varies THUMBNAILS only; there is no native simultaneous title A/B. So B is EITHER (a) a sequential swap — ship A, switch to B after ~7d, compare like-for-like periods — OR (b) a documented fallback if A hits a conflict at upload. If you run (a), log it to ab_raw_data.csv as a title test and note the swap date, because the comparison is across time rather than concurrent and is therefore confounded by decay. If (b), record that B was never live so a future read does not treat it as a tested-and-lost variant.

description:
Unwind Slowly | Slow Sarod | 1.5 Hours of Calm of Slow the evening down and let the day finish

The evening arrives and there is still a list running in your head. Nothing on it has to happen now.

This peaceful Indian ambient meditation music is designed to slow the evening down and let the day finish.

Enjoy 1.5 hours of warm sarod melodies over a soft tanpura drone, looped seamlessly so nothing interrupts you.

Perfect for evening wind-down, reading, cooking, a bath, journalling, stretching, quiet company, switching off after work, early night, doing nothing at all.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Sarod
Raga: Bageshri
Style: Indian classical ambient, instrumental only
Mood: Calm, steady, unhurried
Duration: 1.5 hours

🎧 HOW TO USE
Keep the volume low enough that it sits underneath the room rather than filling it. Headphones deepen the drone, but this works just as well through a speaker.

⏱ CHAPTERS
0:00 — Setting the day down
9:00 — Letting the room go quiet
18:00 — Softening
27:00 — Unhurried
36:00 — Warmth settling
45:00 — Nothing pressing
54:00 — Slower still
63:00 — Ease
72:00 — Quiet continuing
81:00 — Drifting toward rest

⏱ BEST FOR
Evening wind-down
Reading before bed
Cooking slowly
A long bath
Journalling
Stretching
Quiet time with someone
Switching off after work
Easing into an early night
Doing nothing on purpose

If this music helped, subscribe to Raga Focus for more uninterrupted Indian ambient healing music.

#UnwindSlowly #SarodMusic #IndianAmbientMusic #EveningCalm
